title: Each component ξ(α) vanishes H^n-a.e. on the part of the carrier in a relatively compact open set where the current vanishes
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P any set and W ⊆ ℝ^P. Let T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) be a GeometricCurrentOn U n. Let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n) representing T: T(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dH^n(x) for every ω ∈ TestFormOn U n. Assume W is open, closure W is compact, closure W ⊆ U, and T vanishes on W (T(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ TestFormOn U n with tsupport ω ⊆ W). Then for every n-covector α ∈ Covector (Euclid P) n, ξ(x)(α) = 0 for H^n⌞(M ∩ W)-almost every x, where H^n = μHE[n]. In Lean: ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R.carrier ∩ W)), R.orient x α = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → IsOpen W → IsCompact (closure W) → closure W ⊆ U → T.VanishesOn W → ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R.carrier ∩ W)), R.orient x α = 0
